chapter.verse: A hang pen sanggamte aw, note' kianga kong paina uh mawkna lo ahihlam nomaumah in na thei uh hi.
Philippi khua ah kote gimthuakin hong kisimmawh himah taleh na theih mah bangun nakpi haksatna kawmkal ah Pasian' Lungdamna Thu note' kiangah Pasian' tha tawh kong genkhia ngam uh hi.
Banghanghiam cihleh kote' thusunna pen paikhialhna, thanghuai gamtatna, leh khem sawmna cihte pan hilo a,
Lungdamna Thu a tangkokhia dingin muanhuai ci-in Pasian' hong kipsakte ka hih mah bangun kote' genkhiat pen mihing' lungkim nading ahilo, kote' lungsim hong sittel Pasian a lungkim nading thu ahi hi.
A hang pen nong theih mah bangun maipha zonna kam ahi-a mihuaihamte' kineihna kam nam ahi zongin ka zang ngeikei uh hi-Pasian pen komau' teci hi.
Mihing' piak phatna minpha zong note' kiangpan ahi-a midangte' kiangpan ahi zongin ka zong kei uh hi.
Khris' sawltak ka hihna uh tawh hong pi-om thei ka hih uh hangin a tate a don a kem nupi bangin note' lakah kong thunem lel uh hi.
Tua hi a, hong it mahmah ka hih manun nakpi deihsakna tawh Pasian' Lungdamna Thu hong genkhia bek ka hikei uh a, ka nunna kha uh zong hong piakhia nuam ka hi uh hi.

A hang pen sanggamte aw, thasanin gimpi-a ka sepna uh phawk un. Note' tungah Pasian' Lungdamna Thu kong tangko laitakun note khat mahmah' tungah vangik kong suahkhak loh nadingun a sun a zan ci lo-in na ka sem uh hi.
No thu-umte' tungah siangthotak, diktak leh paubaanglo-in hong gamta ka hihlam uh nomaumah teci na hi uh a, Pasian zong ahi hi.
A hang pen na theih mah bangun pa in a tate a bawl danin kong bawl uh a,
ama' kumpigam leh minphatna sungah note hong samkhia Pasian' zia tawh kituakin na nuntak nadingun note khat ciat hong thumin hong thapia-in kong hansuah uh hi.

Tua banah ko' tungpan na zak uh Pasian' thu hong tun ciangin mihing' thugen hi ci lo-in no thu-umte' sunga a gamtang Pasian' thu ci-in ahi bang lianin sang na hih manun zong Pasian' hehpihna ka phat den uh hi.

A hang pen sanggamte aw, Judea gam sunga om Khris Jesu a um Pasian' pawlpite in Jew mite tungpan gimna a thuak mah bangun note zong na mipihte uh' tungpan tua bang gimna mah thuak na hih manun amaute' khekhap a zui na hi uh hi.
Tua Jew mite in Topa Jesu hitaleh kamsangte hitaleh thatin kote zong nakpi hong bawlsia uh a, Pasian' lungsim tuak lo-in mi khempeuh tawh kigalneih uh hi.
tua Jew mite in-a mawhna uh a kiim dong a dimsak den ahih nadingun-Gentile mite hotkhiat ngah nadinga thu ka gen uh pen hong khaktan uh a, ahih hangin amau' tungah hehna a tawp dongin tung khinzo hi.
Ahi zongin sanggamte aw, note tawh lungsim a kikhen hilo, tawmvei sung pumpi a kikhen i hih manin maitang kituah-a kimuhkik ding lawpzaw kanin nakpi lunggulhna tawh ka hanciam uh hi.
Note' kiangah kong painop uh hangin-keimah Paul in ka hanciam zelzel hangin-Satan in hong khaktan hi.
Ahihleh i Topa Jesu hong pai ciangin ama' mai-ah kote' lametna, ahihkeileh kote' lungdamna, ahihkeileh kote' kipakna lukhu, bang ahi ding hiam? No hilo na hi uh hiam?
Note pen kote' minphatna leh lungdamna na hi uh hi.
